# The N-Gage QD (RH-29, firmware 4.10) talking to its Bluetooth module, as
# the reference model logged it (model/run.sh, bt.log, times removed): a
# start to the idle screen, then Tools > Bluetooth, the name accepted,
# Bluetooth switched on, and Paired devices > New paired device with
# nobody in range. sim/harness/bt_main.cpp replays it on the core's module.
#   reset requested / reset done   the driver's reset through register 6
#   HCI< bytes                     a packet from the phone
#   HCI> bytes                     the module's packet for the phone

reset done
